title: Conditional entire source-weight generating envelope for repeated onsite words
question: Can an entire source weight absorb the full factorial generating function of the prescribed repeated onsite word family after fixed-degree weights fail?
method: Use the exact word coefficient |R_m(a)|=m c (G/4)^(m-1)|a|^(4m-3) at q=r=0.
Rewrite the factorial series as c t |a| times the exponential series with rate (tG/4)|a|^4.
Test sigma=1/5 against the exact rate 17/140 and check finite positive Taylor partial sums at five amplitudes.
Compile Lean R216 only for the rational rate, positive margin, prefactor, and one finite series-term fixture.
finding: Primary passes 14/14 and independent passes 13/13; the integrated lane passes 22/22 and Lean R216 passes. For the declared prescribed-word family, the generating identity is c t |a| exp((tG/4)|a|^4). The fixture has rate 17/140, sigma 1/5, positive margin 11/140, and ratio prefactor 2/9, so the entire candidate weight dominates the word-family envelope.
decision_reason: This supplies the surviving analytic candidate after EXP-001031's fixed-polynomial escalation. It remains conditional: the actual Q3 history, cancellations, domain, six-neighbour path count, volume uniformity and exhaustion are not derived.
